_comment: ARJUN Phase 2 default model registry. Drop this into <app_data>/models/registry.json (or merge it into your existing one). The parent agent model is OpenReasoning-Nemotron-7B Q4_K_M: the smallest dense reasoning model that clears the 7B coding floor, and the only candidate that fits a 4 GB VRAM card with partial CPU offload. Sub-agents inherit this model through their profile.

models._comment: Optional fallback: MoE 35B, very slow on 4 GB VRAM, kept enabled so a parent can fall back if Nemotron is not installed. Set enabled=false to remove.
models.name: Qwen3.6 35B A3B
